title: My ex soft-launched his new girlfriend in my dress

voice.name: Kitty
voice.direction: sultry, smirking, brisk TikTok storytelling pace

hooks.text: My ex soft-launched his new girlfriend... in my dress.
I recognized my ex's new girlfriend by her sleeve.
His new girlfriend bought her first-date dress from me.

beats.text: My ex soft-launched his new girlfriend... in *my* dress.
beats.visual: Phone post fills frame: Jake's story, just a shoulder in a green dress. Tiff's face drops behind the phone. Text hook: HE SOFT-LAUNCHED HER.

beats.text: The green one. I sold it last month to clear my *chair*.
beats.visual: Tiff's room, flashback: Tiff snaps the green dress off the chair pile.

beats.text: Same slit. Same tiny *burn mark* from my birthday candles.
beats.visual: Push in on the phone: a tiny burn mark glows on the sleeve.

beats.text: He captioned it: finally, someone with *taste*.
beats.visual: Phone: caption pops under the post; Jake smug inset.
Comment bubbles stack up fast, hearts and fire emojis.

beats.text: So I checked who bought the dress. *Sasha*. Two days before their first date.
beats.visual: Laptop: Tiff's sold listing, buyer name Sasha; calendar flips.

beats.text: Then Sasha messaged me: wait, are you *his* Tiff?
beats.visual: Message pops on the laptop; Tiff freezes.

beats.text: I sent her one screenshot. She sent back *twelve*.
beats.visual: Split phone screens: one bubble from Tiff, a wall of screenshots back.

beats.text: Turns out he told us both the *same* lines.
beats.visual: Two identical texts side by side glow red.

beats.text: She kept the dress. I listed everything he ever touched on *pileGo*.
beats.visual: Tiff's room: she snaps Jake's hoodie, cap and mug; listings fan out to app tiles.

beats.text: We have a group chat now. He's *not* in it.
beats.visual: Tiff on her bed grinning at her phone; group chat header 'EX FILES'.
